mechanism: Higher MoO3 temperature raises MoO3-x vapor supply and growth rate, so domains grow larger from 1073 to 1098 K.
At 1123 K the oversupplied precursor drives higher nucleation density and competing crystals, shrinking domain size (or yielding thick/multilayer growth), so size peaks near 1098 K.
Greater MoO3 vapor flux gives higher supersaturation at the substrate and thus more nucleation sites per area.
